summary: T2-04 passes. All three story checks succeed: 108 tests pass, mypy is clean, and make check is clean (ruff and mypy). The change touches only polarimetry.py and test_polarimetry_derive.py, both in the story's files list. derive_circular wraps the existing Stokes and covariance conversions. The block aggregation sums linear powers per block before taking ratios. It returns both statistics under separate names, keeps per-block counts, and reports no value for blocks with no valid pixels. I did not run a failing-first check; the diff shows the tests commit (fe188e2) before the implementation (fd70837), which is consistent with it.

checks.evidence: Success: no issues found in 11 source files
ruff check passed, ruff format --check passed, mypy: no issues found in 12 source files

checks.criterion: AC1: derive_circular interface, per-pixel state and reason, unknown kind or convention raises, F1-F7 equal story 2/3 results
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:1520-1581 derive_circular delegates to circular_from_stokes and circular_from_covariance; tests at test_polarimetry_derive.py:303-330 (raises), 453-512 (F1-F7, including an array equality test against circular_from_stokes at line 487). The returned records carry state and reason arrays.

checks.criterion: AC2: ratio of mean powers vs mean of pixelwise ratios, separately named, differing case
checks.evidence: test_two_pixels_give_different_named_statistics (line 536, expects 2/3) and test_full_block_hand_computed_statistics (line 564); fields ratio_of_mean_powers and mean_of_pixelwise_ratios in BlockAggregates (polarimetry.py:1727-1728), primary_statistic is ratio_of_mean_powers.

checks.criterion: AC3: exclusion and counts, zero-valid block gives no value, OC<=0 handling documented
checks.evidence: BlockSupport holds n_valid, n_missing, n_invalid_by_reason and valid_fraction (polarimetry.py:1649-1697). _no_valid_pixels returns MISSING or INVALID with reason BLOCK_NO_VALID_PIXELS and a NaN value. Tests at lines 580-660. The aggregate_blocks docstring documents that a zero-OC pixel's SC and OC enter the power means but not the pixelwise-CPR mean.

checks.criterion: AC4: dB cannot be aggregated, display-only dB helper, amplitude never averaged as power
checks.evidence: DecibelArray and to_db_for_display (polarimetry.py:1588-1628); aggregate_blocks raises TypeError for any type other than the two linear-power records (line 1955). Tests at lines 826-895.

checks.criterion: AC5: block size as an argument, block origin returned, blocks_independent False
checks.evidence: The block_size argument is required and not hard-coded (polarimetry.py:1899-1903, block_origin at 1972-1977). BlockAggregates rejects blocks_independent=True (1738). Tests at lines 688-770.

checks.criterion: AC6: Hypothesis permutation and scaling properties
checks.evidence: @given tests at test_polarimetry_derive.py:955 (permutation), 981 (common-factor scaling), 998 and 1039 (power-of-two scaling and exact oracle); all in the 108 passing tests.

findings.claim: The commit range also changes scripts/ralph files (prd.json, progress.txt) outside the story's files list.
findings.evidence: git diff --stat shows prd.json and progress.txt changed. These are orchestrator bookkeeping and were excluded from the review diff. No finding against the implementation.

resolution.reason: The two changed paths outside the story's files are this batch's story list (scripts/ralph/batches/t2-polarimetry/prd.json) and progress log (progress.txt). The Ralph author instructions permit exactly these beside the story's files (section 2: 'Change only paths that match the story's files patterns, plus the story list and the progress log'), and the loop's scope check leaves them out: outside_paths in scripts/ralph/ralph.sh diffs with WORK_SPEC=(':!scripts/ralph' ':!reviews' ':!logs') (line 49). The finding itself says it is no finding against the implementation, and both codex scope checks with the same exclusions list only polarimetry.py and test_polarimetry_derive.py. No change needed.
